description: Implementation of the rx::Query11 class for Direct3D 11 queries in ANGLE, handling query lifecycle, result retrieval, and GPU timing.

classes.name: Query11
classes.description: Implements D3D11 query handling for ANGLE, managing query states, results, and timing.

classes.name: Query11::QueryState
classes.description: Holds the state of an individual query, including timestamps and completion status.

methods.name: MergeQueryResults
methods.description: Merges two query results based on the query type.

methods.name: Query11::Query11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the query with renderer and type.

methods.name: Query11::begin
methods.description: Starts the query, preparing for result collection.

methods.name: Query11::queryCounter
methods.description: Handles timestamp query, not supported in D3D11.

methods.name: Query11::getResultBase
methods.description: Retrieves the query result, ensuring all data is flushed.

methods.name: Query11::getResult
methods.description: Overloaded functions to get query results as different types.

methods.name: Query11::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: Query11::pause
methods.description: Pauses the query, ending current query and storing state.

methods.name: Query11::resume
methods.description: Resumes or starts a new query.

methods.name: Query11::testQuery
